# truenas_cloudsync_credentials (Resource)

Manages TrueNAS cloud sync credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_cloudsync_credentials" "backup_s3" {
  name = "backup-s3"
  provider_config = jsonencode({
    type              = "S3"
    access_key_id     = "AKIA..."
    secret_access_key = "..."
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the cloud sync credentials.
- `provider_config` (String, Sensitive) JSON document of provider settings. Must include "type" (e.g. S3, B2, GOOGLE_CLOUD_STORAGE, STORJ_IX). May contain secrets (access keys); use provider_secrets_wo to keep secret keys out of state. Compared as JSON: any spelling works, keys the server adds are not a change, and `url`/`endpoint` compare as URLs (host case, default port and a trailing slash are ignored). Generated configuration (`terraform plan -generate-config-out`) has this as null, because Terraform never writes sensitive or write-only values there; fill it in before applying.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `provider_secrets_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only JSON object of secret provider settings (e.g. an S3 access key/secret) merged over provider_config when sending to TrueNAS. Never stored in state, and not read back on refresh. Requires provider_secrets_wo_version.
- `provider_secrets_wo_version` (Number) Version trigger for provider_secrets_wo. Bump to re-send a changed write-only secret overlay. The overlay is sent on create and when this integer changes; other updates send the secret values TrueNAS already has (the API needs the whole object), so a changed secret is applied only with a version bump. Required when provider_secrets_wo is set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric cloud sync credentials ID assigned by TrueNAS.
